statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
These symptoms cannot be identified by routine evaluation (R42)
The service is medically necessary to detect transient cardiac events underlying the recurrent symptoms
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
